title: A House on Four Clocks
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：time　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 time 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My mother worked nights for eleven years, which meant our house ran on a different ① time from the street outside. I learned the ② time from the radio, which said it twice an hour, and from the bin men, who came on Tuesdays whatever else happened. Nobody in our family was ever ③ on time for anything, because being on time is a property of a single clock and we had four, and none of them agreed.

The hardest ④ time was between four and six in the morning, when the house was empty of sleep and full of nothing else. I read then, badly and greedily, and I have never since been able to read at any other ⑤ time of day with the same attention. My mother said what a day is for is not what the clock says, and she was right, though it took me years to see it.

By my estimate she made the walk to the bus eleven thousand ⑥ times in eleven years, and she counted them in a notebook, which is the only arithmetic I ever saw her enjoy. She ⑦ timed everything: the walk (nine minutes), the kettle (four), the night shift (eleven hours and a half-hour she never took). At ⑧ times she would come home and sit at the table with her coat still on, for twenty minutes, doing nothing at all, and I learned not to speak during those twenty minutes.

In ⑨ times like these, people say, nobody can plan; she planned eleven years ahead, in a notebook with four columns. What the notebook showed, which she never said, was that she had given up roughly three ⑩ times as much sleep as anybody else in the house, and had never once mentioned it.

The notebook is in a drawer and I have never re-read it. Time, my mother said once, is not money and it is not a line; it is whatever the house is doing. What I kept from those eleven years is a small and useful habit: knowing not what time it is, but what it is for.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 时间（抽象概念）
B. n. 一段时间；时期；时段
C. n. 次；回（eleven thousand times）
E. n. 时代；时势；年头（in times like these）
F. v. 计时；测定……所需时间
G. 固定搭配：on time 准时；按时
H. 固定搭配：at times 有时；间或

items.q: a different time from the street outside
I learned the time from the radio
Nobody in our family was ever on time
The hardest time was between four and six
at any other time of day
eleven thousand times in eleven years
At times she would come home

answers.why: 指与外界不同的“时间、作息”，说家里和街上的时间不是一回事。
指从收音机得知的“时间”，每小时报两次。
on time 意为“准时”，说家里没人守时，因为守时只属于一口钟。
指凌晨四点到六点这一段“时间、时段”，是最难熬的。
指一天中其他的“时间”，说此后在任何别的时段都读不进书。
times 意为“次、回”，说十一年里她走了大约一万一千趟。
time 作动词，意为“计时、测定……要多久”，故后文列出步行九分钟、水壶四分钟。
at times 意为“有时、间或”，说她偶尔回家后穿着外套静坐二十分钟。
in times like these 意为“在这样的年头、时势下”，是常见套语。
three times as ... 意为“三倍于……”，说她少睡的时间约是家里其他人的三倍。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我们家的作息和街上完全不同。（time）
我们家没有人做任何事准时过。（on time）
最难熬的是凌晨四点到六点那段时间。（time）
十一年里她大约走了一万一千趟。（times）
她给每件事计时：步行九分钟，水壶四分钟。（time v.）
她放弃的睡眠大约是家里其他人的三倍。（three times as）
answers: Our house ran on a different time from the street outside.
Nobody in our family was ever on time for anything.
The hardest time was between four and six in the morning.
In eleven years she made that walk about eleven thousand times.
She timed everything: the walk took nine minutes and the kettle four.
She gave up roughly three times as much sleep as anybody else in the house.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 time 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Because my mother worked nights, our house ran on a different time from the street outside.
Nobody in our family was ever on time, because we had four clocks and none of them agreed.
The hardest time was between four and six in the morning, and that was when I learned to read.
In eleven years she made the walk to the bus eleven thousand times, and she counted them in a notebook.
She timed everything, and at times she would sit at the table with her coat still on for twenty minutes.
She had given up roughly three times as much sleep as anybody else, and never once mentioned it.
